title: Addition of the adaptor to RNA substrates for 3′ RACE
author: Matus Valach
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xsyfnfw

steps.title: Prepare 9 µL adaptor ligation mix
steps.instruction: Mix the specified components to a total volume of 9 µL; blocking the 3′ end of the 3′ RACE oligo is not required because 3′‑OH ends are not substrates for EcRtcB RNA ligase, and the 5′ end must be hydroxylated. A 5′ RACE RNA oligo (typically hydroxylated at both ends) can be used as the 3′ RACE oligo when mapping 3′‑P ends with EcRtcB.

steps.title: Denature ligation mixture
steps.instruction: Heat the mixture for 2 minutes at 70 °C, then immediately place it on ice.

steps.title: Add second ligation components
steps.instruction: Mix the following components to reach a final volume of 20 µL (components are as described in the original protocol).

steps.title: Incubate ligation reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction for 120 minutes at 37 °C.

steps.title: Purify ligated RNA
steps.instruction: Purify the RNA from the ligase reaction using either Trizol extraction or a column‑based clean‑up.

steps.title: RT‑PCR with adaptor‑ligated RNA
steps.instruction: Use 250–500 ng of the purified adaptor‑ligated RNA for reverse transcription with a primer reverse‑complementary to the 3′ adaptor; then perform PCR with an upstream (forward) primer binding to the RNA of interest and a downstream (reverse) primer binding to the 3′ adaptor.
